text.tspan: Loan from a financial institution, poorest 40% vs. richest 60% 2022
The percentage of respondents aged 15 and older who reported borrowing money from a bank or another type
of financial institution or using a credit card in the past year.

tspan.tspan: Where data for 2022 is unavailable, the value from the closest year between 2017 and 2021 is shown instead.
